##### Project general facts

Mangrove Village is an exclusive gated community of four- and five-bedroom villas that has established itself as one of the most sought-after neighbourhoods in the capital and is open to buyers of all nationalities. Each villa rises from a ground floor to a first floor and is planned around generously proportioned entertaining and living spaces, verandas and expansive private gardens. A maid's room, a separate laundry room, independent chilling systems and ample storage make every home practical for large families.

The community combines resort-style leisure with everyday convenience. Residents enjoy a private beach with a beach club house, a marina and kayaking, together with indoor and outdoor pools, kids' pools and a shaded kids' playground. Sports facilities include an indoor gym, a ladies' gym, an outdoor gym, a sauna, padel, tennis and basketball courts, a football pitch, a jogging track and a yoga deck, while a supermarket, a cafe, a nursery and a dedicated concierge complete the offer.

Homes are designed for comfortable family living, with bright interiors, practical layouts and a smooth connection between indoor rooms, verandas and gardens. Living and dining areas are spacious enough for entertaining, and bedrooms offer quiet, private retreats. Round-the-clock security, a resident relations officer and a maintenance call centre support residents every day, along with a varied calendar of social events. Villas are delivered with fitted kitchens, and the community is managed with expert care.

##### Location description and benefits

Rabdan is a residential district on the mainland of Abu Dhabi, set along the creek opposite Abu Dhabi Island and close to the historic Al Maqta area. The neighbourhood combines quiet gated communities, waterfront promenades and green spaces with schools, clinics and supermarkets, giving families a calm setting within easy reach of the city's main destinations, business districts and cultural landmarks.

Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre and Khalifa City are a short drive away, while the Sheikh Zayed Bridge and Al Maqta Bridge connect residents with the city centre and the Corniche. Yas Island, Saadiyat Island and Zayed International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, and Abu Dhabi–Dubai Highway links the area with Dubai for daily commuters and weekend trips.

Rabdan offers a rare combination of waterfront living, established infrastructure and a central mainland position. Gated villa communities with private beach and marina access are in limited supply in the capital, supporting steady demand from families and long-term tenants. Freehold ownership for all nationalities, mature landscaping and proximity to the airport and the city centre underpin long-term value for owners and investors.
